Imagine being able to think something, and another person immediately understands and responds without any verbal exchange. It has also opened up new forms of collaboration and creativity, as artists and thinkers can share their ideas in real-time, transcending geographical and cultural barriers.

Beyond human-to-human communication, these neural interfaces have also facilitated interaction between humans and machines. Devices can now understand and respond to human thoughts, making them more intuitive and user-friendly. For instance, a person might simply think "increase the volume," and their headphones will adjust accordingly. This level of integration has made technology an extension of our own bodies, enhancing our capabilities and transforming everyday tasks into seamless experiences.

The natural world too has been given a voice through these interfaces. Plants, animals, and even geological formations can now be monitored and communicated with at a fundamental level.
